title: 美银Maddie Jow：AI基建拉动电网设备出口，中国电网投资年增两位数
speaker: Maddie Jow

segments.en: Yeah, so for ESS upstream, of course you have lithium, midstream, you have CATL, and some of the other battery names as well. And downstream probably like Sungrove, Tesla, these are the major, you know, the ESS producers.
segments.zh: 对于储能系统，上游有锂，中游有宁德时代等电池企业，下游有阳光电源、特斯拉等主要储能系统生产商。

segments.en: And ESS order has been very, very strong year today as well. You alluded to some of this earlier about the build out in China.
segments.zh: 今年储能订单非常强劲。你之前提到了中国的建设。

segments.en: In terms of the data center building, what is the downstream impact perhaps on construction, on industrial growth as well? Yeah, so we are actually seeing a lot of the construction and industrial growth that are very lean towards the AI growth.
segments.zh: 数据中心建设对下游建筑和工业增长有何影响？我们看到许多建筑和工业增长都倾向于AI增长。

segments.en: For example, the great investments. We are actually seeing this five years government policies, great investment compared to the previous five years to grow by 40%. And this year we are expecting a great investment to grow by double digit as well.
segments.zh: 例如电网投资。我们看到这五年政府政策下的电网投资相比前五年增长了40%。今年我们预计电网投资也将实现两位数增长。

segments.en: So that benefiting a lot of the great players, at the same time China is also trying to export a lot of our equipment on the on the on the power side, like for example, transformer gas turbine related.
segments.zh: 这使许多电网企业受益，同时中国也在努力出口大量电力设备，例如变压器、燃气轮机等。
